entries.alt: Four fictional adult women share a back hug and linked-hand moment above Battir's terraced olive hills. Black, white, green and red short fashion looks pair with white boots, black RAZE sandals and rainbow platforms; star and crescent tattoos are visible.

Four fictional adult women overlap in a close side hug beside the archaeological terraces of Tell es-Sultan, Jericho. Palestinian flag looks, a green top and black RAZE shorts frame an IA tattoo. A distant smoke cloud is part of this fictional AI scene, not a report of a real event.

Four fictional adult women share a seated hand clasp and shoulder embrace in a shaded pavilion overlooking Hisham's Palace mosaics. Short green, white, red and black looks pair with rainbow knee-highs, platforms, green pumps and rainbow ankle boots.

Four fictional adult women lean together on a terrace above Wadi Qelt's pale canyon, with a supported head-on-shoulder rest and joined hands. Flag-patterned and green short looks pair with sheer star knee-highs, red heels, rainbow ankle boots and green boots.
